Used a minimal, physically-valid pure-1→0 program proof instead: a distinctive 64-byte ramp (writeA.bin, 0x00..0x3F) written into a currently-all-0xFF scratch region. `firestarter dev write-cycle` correctly NOT used (erases first → fails on UV EPROM). Both writes used -b only, no --skip-erase, no --force (SAFE-01 intact).
